subject: Communication Systems
questionText:
Common Data for Q.1 and 2 : 
A continuously operating coherent BPSK system 
makes errors at the average rate of 100 errors per day. 
The data rate is 1000 bits/sec. The single sided noise 
power spectral density is N0 =10–10 W/Hz. 
1.
If the system is ergodic, what is the average bit error
probability?
(a)
8.64 × 10–6 
(b) 8.64 × 10–7
(c)
1.16 × 10–5 
(d) 1.16 × 10–7
explanation: Practice Question from Communication Systems DPP-06 (PRACTICE SHEET 01).
